seo.title: Case Study: PS Flooring — Bilingual Website for a Flooring Company | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built a bilingual platform with a catalog, shopping cart, quotes, and order management panel for Plus Solution Flooring Corp in Florida, USA.

hero.title: PS Flooring — from local service to a
hero.subtitle: A flooring sales and installation company in Florida, USA, that needed to bring material sales and customer acquisition for its installation services together in one place.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: PS Flooring had been operating in a traditional way: phone inquiries, manual quotes, and no clear way to sell materials or showcase their catalog online. They needed to expand into new services (like epoxy) and serve both English- and Spanish-speaking customers, without duplicating effort across two separate sites.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I built a bilingual platform (English/Spanish) with a product and service catalog, a shopping cart calculated by square footage, a user account system, checkout with online payments, and an estimate calculator so customers could get a quote before reaching out. I also added a panel with order history and a dedicated section for the new epoxy service.
incluye: Catalog with shopping cart calculated by square footage
User account system with order history
Dedicated page for the epoxy service

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: The company now has a platform ready to attract new customers, sell materials online, and evolve its business model from services toward a hybrid offering of installation and product sales, with an order flow working end to end.
